global_style.art_style: Cinematic 2D thriller graphic novel illustration, premium animated crime-thriller storyboard aesthetic, semi-realistic hand-painted digital art, dramatic directional lighting, rich midnight blue and amber color palette, subtle film grain, detailed urban environments, expressive character acting, strong silhouettes, dynamic camera compositions, Dutch angles, dramatic close-ups, over-the-shoulder perspectives, cinematic depth of field. Every image should capture one precise moment of action, not a generic summary of an entire scene. Maintain visual continuity while changing camera angle, framing, and character pose frequently.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, 3D rendering, anime, cute cartoon style, flat vector art, static repeated compositions, empty backgrounds, excessive gore, graphic injuries, distorted anatomy, inconsistent character appearance, extra fingers, blurry faces, readable text, subtitles, watermarks, logos.

kabir.label: Kabir - the journalist
kabir.visual_dna: A 28-year-old Indian male investigative journalist with short black hair, light stubble, sharp brown eyes, wearing a dark charcoal shirt with rolled sleeves, black trousers, and a dark wristwatch. Carries a black messenger bag. Lean build, observant expression. Keep his face, hairstyle, clothing, and accessories consistent.

meera.label: Meera - the missing woman
meera.visual_dna: An Indian woman around 30 years old with shoulder-length wavy black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow kurta and dark trousers. Intelligent expressive eyes, medium build. Her appearance in photographs and flashbacks must remain consistent.

security_guard.label: The night security guard
security_guard.visual_dna: A middle-aged Indian man with a thick moustache, slightly balding head, dark blue security uniform, and a small flashlight clipped to his belt. Nervous eyes and a hesitant expression.

inspector.label: The police inspector
inspector.visual_dna: An Indian male police inspector in his early forties, neatly combed black hair, trimmed moustache, khaki police uniform, and a stern investigative expression. Maintain consistent uniform and facial features.

apartment.label: The old apartment building
apartment.visual_dna: An aging six-storey apartment building in an Indian city, with stained concrete walls, narrow corridors, old metal railings, a dim staircase, and a flickering tube light. The building feels ordinary but unsettling at night.

room_604.label: Apartment 604
room_604.visual_dna: A locked apartment on the sixth floor, with a dark wooden door, brass number plate, dusty peephole, and a narrow ventilation window above the door. Inside is a modest living room with an old sofa, table, curtains, and a wall clock.

corridor.label: Sixth-floor corridor
corridor.visual_dna: A narrow apartment corridor with pale peeling walls, old electrical wiring, a flickering tube light, dusty floor, and several closed doors. The corridor has a long perspective and deep shadows.

notebook.label: Kabir's investigation notebook
notebook.visual_dna: A small black notebook with worn corners, filled with handwritten notes, rough building sketches, and dates. No readable text.

photograph.label: Meera's photograph
photograph.visual_dna: A slightly faded printed photograph of {assets.meera}, showing her standing in front of the old apartment building. The photograph has a folded corner and faint scratches.

key.label: Old apartment key
key.visual_dna: A single old brass key with a small blue plastic tag, slightly scratched and tarnished.

phone.label: Kabir's smartphone
phone.visual_dna: A modern black smartphone with a dark case and slightly scratched screen. Its screen can illuminate faces in dark environments. No visible brand or readable text.

beats.narration_text: कबीर को एक ऐसी लड़की की कहानी मिली थी, जो छह महीने पहले अचानक गायब हो गई थी। उसका आखिरी पता था... एक पुरानी इमारत का कमरा नंबर छह सौ चार।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.apartment} at night from a dramatic low street-level angle. One window on the sixth floor is faintly illuminated while the rest of the building is dark. Light rain reflects on the road.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the mysterious apartment building and the missing woman's last known location.

beats.narration_text: कबीर वहाँ पहुँचा तो इमारत लगभग खाली थी। उसने अपनी जेब से मीरा की तस्वीर निकाली और दरबान को दिखा दी।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} standing at the entrance of {assets.apartment}, holding {assets.photograph} toward {assets.security_guard}. The guard studies the photograph nervously.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce Kabir, the missing woman, and the nervous security guard.

beats.narration_text: तस्वीर देखते ही दरबान के चेहरे का रंग बदल गया। उसने धीरे से कहा... साहब, आप छठी मंज़िल पर मत जाइए।
beats.prompt_action: Show a close-up of {assets.security_guard}'s worried face, his eyes shifting toward the staircase. Kabir's photograph is partly visible in the foreground.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create an immediate hook through the guard's fearful reaction.

beats.narration_text: कबीर ने उसकी बात अनसुनी की और सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ने लगा। हर मंज़िल पर उसे लगता रहा कि कोई उसके पीछे चल रहा है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} climbing the narrow staircase of {assets.apartment}, one hand on the railing and the other holding his phone. A vague human-shaped shadow appears on the lower flight behind him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Build tension through upward movement and a suspicious shadow.

beats.narration_text: छठी मंज़िल पर पहुँचकर वह रुक गया। सामने कमरे का दरवाज़ा था... और उसके नीचे से हल्की रोशनी बाहर आ रही थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.room_604} from floor level. A thin line of warm light escapes from beneath the closed door into the dark corridor. {assets.kabir}'s shoes enter the frame.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the first physical clue that the supposedly empty apartment may be occupied.

beats.narration_text: उसने दरवाज़े पर कान लगाया। अंदर से किसी के चलने की आवाज़ आ रही थी। फिर अचानक सब शांत हो गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} leaning close to the wooden door of {assets.room_604}, listening carefully. His expression changes from curiosity to alertness.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on the exact moment he hears movement stop inside.

beats.narration_text: तभी अंदर से तीन बार दस्तक हुई। कबीर पीछे हट गया... क्योंकि उसने तो दरवाज़ा खटखटाया ही नहीं था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} recoiling from {assets.room_604} as the wooden door vibrates slightly from three knocks coming from inside. The corridor light flickers above him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Deliver a sharp suspense beat with the unexplained knocks.

beats.narration_text: कबीर ने तुरंत दरबान को फोन किया। लेकिन फोन उठाने के बजाय, दरबान ने नीचे से इमारत का मुख्य दरवाज़ा बंद कर दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} holding {assets.phone} near the locked apartment door, looking confused. In a small visual cutaway, show {assets.security_guard} downstairs pulling the building's metal gate shut.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the guard's suspicious action and raise the stakes.

beats.narration_text: अब कबीर को यकीन हो गया कि दरबान कुछ छिपा रहा है। उसने दरवाज़े के पास लगी छोटी खिड़की से अंदर झाँकने की कोशिश की।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} standing on his toes and peering through the narrow ventilation window above {assets.room_604}. One eye is visible through the gap, with the dark room beyond.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Move the investigation toward a direct look inside the apartment.

beats.narration_text: अंदर एक कुर्सी रखी थी। उस पर मीरा की तस्वीरें थीं... और दीवार पर लगी घड़ी उल्टी दिशा में चल रही थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show the interior of {assets.room_604} through the narrow window: a chair covered with photographs of {assets.meera}, a table, and an old wall clock with hands positioned strangely. The room is dimly lit.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the strange arrangement inside the apartment as separate visual clues.

beats.narration_text: तभी कमरे के अंदर से एक आवाज़ आई... कबीर, तुम बहुत देर से आए हो।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} pulling his face away from the ventilation window, eyes widened in shock. His hand grips the wall for support.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the unknown voice feel personal and directly connected to Kabir.

beats.narration_text: कबीर ने तुरंत पूछा, अंदर कौन है? जवाब आया... वही, जिसे तुम ढूँढ रहे हो।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} facing the closed door of {assets.room_604}, speaking toward it. The peephole appears dark, with a faint reflection of his face.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the mystery focused on the unseen person inside.

beats.narration_text: अचानक दरवाज़े के नीचे से एक पुरानी चाबी बाहर सरककर आई। कबीर ने उसे उठाया और ताला खोल दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.key} sliding across the dusty floor from beneath {assets.room_604}. {assets.kabir}'s hand reaches down to pick it up.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the key and show Kabir crossing the point of no return.

beats.narration_text: दरवाज़ा खुला तो अंदर कोई नहीं था। बस मेज़ पर एक खुली डायरी रखी थी, जिसके पहले पन्ने पर कबीर का नाम लिखा था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} standing in the doorway of {assets.room_604}. The room is empty, with an open notebook on the central table. A narrow beam of light falls on the page.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create an unsettling empty-room reveal and introduce the notebook.

beats.narration_text: उसने डायरी खोली। अंदर की सारी तारीखें आने वाले दिनों की थीं... और आखिरी पन्ने पर लिखा था, आज रात कबीर यहाँ मरेगा।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} holding open {assets.notebook} on the table. The pages contain several future dates and a final ominous handwritten line, but the writing should remain visually indistinct and unreadable.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the chilling prediction and make Kabir's own safety the central mystery.

beats.narration_text: उसी पल बाहर से पुलिस की आवाज़ आई। कबीर ने दरवाज़े की तरफ देखा... और राहत की साँस ली।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} turning toward the apartment entrance as a bright flashlight beam cuts through the corridor. The open doorway frames the dark hallway.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create a brief moment of relief before the final twist.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन अंदर आने वाला पुलिस इंस्पेक्टर उसे देखकर चौंक गया। उसने कहा... कबीर? तुम यहाँ क्या कर रहे हो? तुम्हें तो तीन दिन पहले गायब बताया गया था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.inspector} entering {assets.room_604} with a flashlight, staring at {assets.kabir} in disbelief. Kabir looks equally confused. The notebook remains open on the table between them.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal that Kabir's own disappearance is part of the mystery.

beats.narration_text: कबीर ने तुरंत अपना फोन निकाला। लेकिन उसमें तारीख तीन दिन आगे की थी... और स्क्रीन पर मीरा का एक नया संदेश चमक रहा था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} holding {assets.phone} with trembling fingers. The screen glows with an incoming message notification from an unknown contact. No readable text or numbers.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the impossible time discrepancy and the new message.

beats.narration_text: संदेश में सिर्फ एक लाइन थी... अब तुम्हारी बारी है, कमरा छह सौ पाँच। कबीर ने धीरे से सामने वाले दरवाज़े की तरफ देखा।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} frozen inside {assets.room_604}, looking through the open doorway toward the opposite apartment door in the corridor. The opposite door is slightly open, with a narrow strip of warm light inside.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Redirect the mystery toward the neighboring apartment and create a final unanswered question.

beats.narration_text: दरवाज़े के पीछे से मीरा की आवाज़ आई... कबीर, इस बार अंदर मत आना। अब बताइए, क्या कबीर को कमरा छह सौ पाँच खोलना चाहिए था?
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.kabir} standing motionless in the long, dark corridor, facing the slightly open door of the neighboring apartment. The inspector is behind him, while the flickering corridor light casts two long shadows toward the camera.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End on the unresolved choice, with the open door acting as the final visual hook.
